parts.question: What did this label say about moderate renal impairment?

result.answer: The DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8, which was in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15, stated that the historical starting dose for moderate renal impairment was 50 mg OD [E1, E2]. This information is historical and has been superseded [E1, E2, E3].
